title: The first camera screen says every scan sends a picture while photo scanning is off and the policy says no image is uploaded
comment: DEFECTS row D-265. Reverts the ef44c26 hunk: the camera shows cam_privacy_line whatever FLAGS.photoId says.
ifMissed: A claims check: every sentence on a screen about what is sent or stored is matched against the privacy policy's list and the network log of the same walk (a picture claim with no upload request is a contradiction).
